snippet.title: Moonlight - Gameplay Teaser 1#
snippet.description:
Your ship has crashed. This alien planet is constantly changing, and every action seems to have consequences. At least you’re alone. Right?

Moonlight is an open-world survival crafting game set on a dynamic planet that you now call home. Seasons change. Crops grow. Diseases spread. Can you find enough resources to survive and build a shelter? And when the time comes, are you willing to leave it behind?

Explore, build, farm, smelt, craft and automate - all in a bid to understand this planet, and eventually escape. Change the landscape. Befriend or kill the local wildlife. There’s more to this planet than meets the eye.

The planet is yours to control - just don’t be surprised by the consequences if you choose to corrupt it.

Moonlight – coming to PC in 2027
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4452390/Moonlight/
